text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, so employees can focus on more interesting work. Productivity tools, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help people save time and work more efficiently. Human-AI collaboration is also becoming common, as workers use AI to make better decisions and solve problems faster. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones will appear, and workers will need new skills. For this reason, companies should offer training and support to help employees adapt to the changing workplace.
